hooks.command: r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$r" ] || exit 0; if [ ! -x "$r/abcd" ] && [ -x "$r/hooks/bootstrap.sh" ] && [ -z "$(find "$r/.bootstrap.attempt" -maxdepth 0 -mmin -10 2>/dev/null)" ]; then : > "$r/.bootstrap.attempt" 2>/dev/null || true; "$r/hooks/bootstrap.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null || true; fi; g=""; [ -x "$r/abcd" ] && g="$r/abcd"; if [ -z "$g" ] && command -v abcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then g=abcd; fi; if [ -n "$g" ]; then exec "$g" hook prompt-router; fi; printf '%s\n' "abcd: the plugin binary is missing and could not be provisioned, so the rules loader is inactive for this prompt — hooks/bootstrap.sh installs it when the session has network access, or install per https://github.com/Partnermedia/abcd#install" >&2; exit 1

[ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] || exit 0; r="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; b=''; s=0; if [ -x "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/bootstrap.sh" ]; then : > "$r/.bootstrap.attempt" 2>/dev/null || true; b=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/bootstrap.sh" 2>&1 >/dev/null </dev/null); s=$?; fi; [ -z "$b" ] || printf '%s\n' "$b" >&2; if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/abcd" ] && [ -x "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/abcd" ]; then i=$(cat); printf '%s' "$i" | "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/abcd" hook session-start; e=$?; printf '%s' "$i" | "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/abcd" hook prompt-router-reset; p=$?; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] || exit "$s"; [ "$e" -eq 0 ] || exit "$e"; exit "$p"; fi; [ -n "$b" ] || printf '%s\n' "abcd: the plugin binary is not installed, so the rule loader did not reset and the session-start checks did not run — hooks/bootstrap.sh provisions it at session start; start a session with network access, or install per https://github.com/Partnermedia/abcd#install" >&2; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] || exit "$s"; exit 2

r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$r" ] || exit 0; if [ ! -x "$r/abcd" ] && [ -x "$r/hooks/bootstrap.sh" ] && [ -z "$(find "$r/.bootstrap.attempt" -maxdepth 0 -mmin -10 2>/dev/null)" ]; then : > "$r/.bootstrap.attempt" 2>/dev/null || true; "$r/hooks/bootstrap.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null || true; fi; g=""; [ -x "$r/abcd" ] && g="$r/abcd"; if [ -z "$g" ] && command -v abcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then g=abcd; fi; if [ -n "$g" ]; then "$g" guard hook; s=$?; [ $s -eq 0 ] || [ $s -eq 1 ] || [ $s -eq 2 ] || { echo "abcd guard: FAILED TO RUN (exit $s) — shell commands run UNGUARDED in this session; run 'abcd ahoy' to see guard health" >&2; exit 1; }; exit $s; fi; printf '%s\n' "abcd guard: the plugin binary is missing, so shell commands run UNGUARDED until it is provisioned — install per https://github.com/Partnermedia/abcd#install" >&2; exit 1

r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$r" ] || exit 0; if [ ! -x "$r/abcd" ] && [ -x "$r/hooks/bootstrap.sh" ] && [ -z "$(find "$r/.bootstrap.attempt" -maxdepth 0 -mmin -10 2>/dev/null)" ]; then : > "$r/.bootstrap.attempt" 2>/dev/null || true; "$r/hooks/bootstrap.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null || true; fi; g=""; [ -x "$r/abcd" ] && g="$r/abcd"; if [ -z "$g" ] && command -v abcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then g=abcd; fi; if [ -n "$g" ]; then exec "$g" hook prompt-router-reset; fi; printf '%s\n' "abcd: the plugin binary is missing, so rules will not re-inject after compaction — install per https://github.com/Partnermedia/abcd#install" >&2; exit 1

r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$r" ] || exit 0; if [ -f "$r/abcd" ] && [ -x "$r/abcd" ]; then exec "$r/abcd" hook session-end; fi; if command -v abcd >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec abcd hook session-end; fi; printf '%s\n' "abcd: the plugin binary is missing, so this session's transcript was not captured — install per https://github.com/Partnermedia/abcd#install" >&2; exit 1
